overview: Compare the selected numbered home’s approved drawing with the contract; a similar bedroom count can conceal a different layout or furnishing schedule.
research.locationNote: Dubai Maritime City, Dubai, as confirmed on the developer’s own page. Advertised travel times and future district transport are not guaranteed commutes or operating connections.
research.priceNote: Danube advertises homes from AED 1.65m. This is the published entry guide checked on 31 October 2026, not a dated quotation for every floor, view or furnished layout. Current allocation and the selected unit’s price require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The developer’s hero advertises 30/70, while its FAQ links eligible homes to a generic 1% monthly arrangement. No project-specific dated primary schedule was retrieved. Casadior separately breaks 30/70 into 10% booking, 20% construction and 70% handover; the displayed stages are that secondary reference, not a confirmed current contract.
research.handoverNote: Danube publishes Q4 2029 as the estimated completion. Confirm the selected building and signed completion provisions; the forecast does not establish readiness, an opening date for every facility or a guaranteed delivery.

facts.value: Studios from 1.65m; 1BR from 2.3m; flex-plus 2BR from 4.25m; 3BR 6.5m. Penthouses: 4BR 15m, 5BR A 22m, 5BR B 20m. Views and configurations differ; these are published guides, not live quotations.

unresolved: Selected published plan totals include balconies. Flex variants have separate footnotes; area ranges are not available-unit inventories or net indoor measurements.
Some broker summaries say 1,444 ft² for premium three bedrooms; the actual plan prints 1,446.

Live availability, final furnishing, parking, service/cooling charges, ownership terms and a dated selected-unit payment calendar remain unverified. Separate retail/nursery layouts and prices do not establish an operating business or residential entitlement. Images remain illustrative.
Pools, club facilities and wellness spaces are planned marketing features. Their operating permissions, access terms and any charges need separate confirmation; no medical outcome is claimed.
